strings.(마을을 둘러보던 중, 호숫가를 하염없이 바라보던 한 소년의 모습이 들어: (While looking around the village, you notice a boy gazing endlessly at the lakeshore.)
Oh... J-Just looking at the lake and wondering what to do...
Well... Well... I'm not sure I should tell you...
strings.글린다 씨 명령, 아니…. 제안으로 해야 할 숙제 같은 게 있는데…. 하: There's some homework I have to do on Miss Glinda's orders... I mean, at her suggestion... If I don't, she'll s-scold me...
strings.제가 도와드릴까요?: Would you like me to help?
R-Really? Thank you... What a relief...
strings.글린다 씨가 마녀잖아요…. 최근에 제 상태를 보시더니 마음을 위한 영약을: Miss Glinda is a witch, you know... Recently, she looked at how I was doing and said she'd make an elixir for my heart...
She said it could make my heart... stronger...
strings.제가 어릴 때부터 소심하고 눈물도 많고 약해서 성격을 바꾸고 싶었거든요…: I've been timid, tearful, and weak since I was little. I wanted to change my personality...
strings.많이 노력했는데… 잘 안돼서…. 결국 말도 안 되는 방법을 찾게 됐는데,: I tried so hard... But it didn't work... Eventually, I turned to something ridiculous: finding a witch and making a wish...
strings.마침 글래스턴 근처에 마녀가 나타난단 이야기를 듣고 돌아다니다 진짜 마녀: I heard a witch had appeared near Glaston, so I went looking and actually met a real witch, Miss Glinda.
strings.……아, 이야기가 길죠…. 나중에 시간 될 때 말을 걸어주시면 제가 따로: ...Oh, I'm talking too much... If you speak to me when you have time later, I'll tell you the rest...
strings.(엘리엇, 나보다 말 잘하는 것 같은데….): (Elliot seems better at talking than I am...)
I've found most of the ingredients, but there are a few I couldn't get...
Where would I even find things like these...?
Don't worry so much. Let me see the ingredients first.
An ominous horn from a high-ranking demon, and a purified horn? No wonder you couldn't find them, Elliot.
strings.그런데 이걸 약의 재료로 쓸 수 있는 건가?: But can these really be used in medicine?
I don't know... Only Miss Glinda, the witch, knows...
strings.이런 건 다 구한 거예요? 고양이 수인의 머리털, 썩은 나무뿌리, 개구리: You got all these? Hair from a cat beastfolk, a rotten tree root, frog eggs, a spirit's tears, a Nab beast's eye...
strings.네…. 대부분 가도하고 마을에서 구했어요. 아…, 마수의 눈만 직접 가서: Yes... I found most of them along the road and in the village. Oh... I had to go get the beast's eye myself...
strings.마수 나브가 잠잘 때 눈을 떼서 잠깐 어디다 붙이거든요…. 제가 그때를: When the Nab beast sleeps, it takes out its eye and sticks it somewhere nearby... I waited for that moment, grabbed it, and ran.
That sounds like it would take quite a lot of courage.
I-I was willing to do even that... If it meant fixing my timid personality...
I'll look into the demon horns. I happen to know a demon.
strings.네? 에, 에에!! 아, 안면이 있는 마족이요?: What? Wh-What?! Y-You know a demon?
strings.아, 그게 마계에서 나와 전향한 마족이에요. 데미갓 리디아 님이 인정한: Oh, he left the Demon Realm and changed sides. You could say he's a good person vouched for by the demigod Lydia.
strings.데, 데미갓이 인정한 마족이라면… 괘, 괜찮은 거겠죠?: I-If a demigod vouches for him... H-He must be all right?
He is. I'll go ask him.
strings.(엘리엇이 눈가에 맺힌 눈물을 닦아내고 살며시 미소를 보인다.): (Elliot wipes the tears from his eyes and gives a small smile.)
strings.이거 한 번 드셔보세요…. 이거 글린다 씨가 주신 건데…. 먹으면 바람: Please try this... Miss Glinda gave it to me... If you eat it, a wind spirit will help carry you on the wind to somewhere near the place you're thinking of...
strings.…저도 한 번 먹은 적이 있었는데…… 괜찮았어요. 배탈 같은 건 없었어요: ...I've tried one before... It was fine. It didn't upset my stomach or anything. And...
Then I'll trust you and try it, Elliot.
strings.왜요? 어? 어? 어어어어어어?!: What is it? Huh? Huh? Whoaaaa?!
strings.(사탕이 모험가의 목으로 넘어가는 순간, 호수 방향에서 돌풍이 일어나 모: (The moment the candy slips down the adventurer's throat, a gust rises from the lake and rushes toward you.)
strings.(바람은 엘리엇이 이야기할 틈도 주지 않은 채 그대로 모험가를 들어 어딘: (Without giving Elliot time to speak, the wind lifts the adventurer and sends you flying away.)
...I was going to say the wind is stronger than you'd expect...
Oh, can you see me? Hehe.
strings.(검고 긴 머리의 소녀가 머리와 보라색 뿔을 긁적거린다.): (A girl with long black hair scratches her head and purple horns.)
Was it my imagination...? I thought something was there...
What a relief. You can't see this big sister after all! If you could, I would have taught you a lesson.
Waiting is boring. Should I follow? Oh, I should report in first. What a pain... Ugh...
strings.(소녀가 머리에 두 손가락을 대고는 눈을 감는다.): (The girl presses two fingers to her head and closes her eyes.)
strings.「팁, 나 티페타. 생각보다 쉽게 뿔을 구할 것 같아. 도로시 마을에서: 「Tip, it's Tipeta. It looks like getting the horns will be easier than expected. I'm stepping out of Dorothy Village for a while.」
strings.(자신을 티페타라고 한 소녀가 머리에서 손을 떼자 등 뒤에 있던 작은 날: (When the girl calling herself Tipeta lowers her hand, the small wings on her back spread wide.)
Where was Invernel again? Oh, the old Highland.
strings.(혼잣말을 남긴 티페타가 그대로 하늘로 날아올라 구름 속으로 사라진다.): (Muttering to herself, Tipeta rises into the sky and disappears among the clouds.)
strings.처음 보는 얼굴인데, 사원 종탑에는 왜 걸려 있었던 걸까? 내려놓느라 애: I don't recognize your face. Why were you caught on the temple's bell tower? It took some effort to get you down.
strings.로말리우스, 저 %s입니다. 아시죠?: Romalius, it's me, %s. You know me, right?
strings.(로말리우스가 눈을 비비더니 다시 %s의 얼굴을 확인한다.): (Romalius rubs his eyes and looks at %s's face again.)
strings.누군가 했더니 너였군. 날개도 없으면서 어쩌다 거기로 날아온 거야?: So it was you. How did you fly up there without wings?
I see. Well, finish your business and head back.
Are you busy right now? I came to ask you something, Romalius.
strings.마침 알바가 끝나고 다른 알바 할 때까지 여유가 조금 있어. 그런데 무슨: I've just finished one part-time job and have a little time before the next. What is it? More work?
I'm making something and need ingredients.
Ingredients? Then I suppose you need a demon's horn.
strings.마수나 마족의 뿔에 강력한 마력이 있어서 그런지는 몰라도 의외로 필요로: Perhaps because the horns of demons and demonic beasts contain powerful magic, they're surprisingly useful.
strings.마법 도구로도 만들기도 하고, 약으로 만들어 먹기도 하고, 장식품으로 쓰: They're made into magical tools, ground into medicine, or used as decorations.
It sounds like nothing goes to waste...
It would be wonderful if they were used for good, but that often isn't the case...
strings.그래서 필요한 뿔이 정화된 거야? 정화되지 않은 거야? 쓰임을 알아야 이: So do you need a purified horn or an unpurified one? I need to know its purpose before I can say.
Both. As for what they're for...
strings.(로말리우스에게 뿔이 필요한 이유를 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain to Romalius why you need the horns.)
strings.오…. 그렇다면 착한 일을 할 수 있다는 거네? 용기가 부족한 소년을 위: Oh... So I can do a good deed? Ingredients for a medicine to help a boy who lacks courage. How lucky.
strings.그렇게 되는군요. 어, 로말리우스. 어디 가요?: I suppose so. Huh, Romalius, where are you going?
strings.(로말리우스가 빠른 걸음으로 사원 안으로 들어가더니, 검은 뭔가를 들고: (Romalius hurries into the temple and returns carrying something black.)
strings.(로말리우스가 부러진 뿔 조각을 %s의 손에 쥐여준다.): (Romalius places a broken horn fragment in %s's hand.)
I thought Lydia took your broken horn...
A little while ago, the Order said they no longer needed it and would return it.
strings.쓸모도 없는 걸 받아서 어떻게 할지 고민하다가 아무 생각 없이 땅에 묻었: I wondered what to do with the useless thing and buried it without thinking. When I checked the next morning, it had grown.
strings.앵무 기자 다니엘 군의 말을 빌리자면, 마족의 뿔은 특수한 경우 이렇게: To borrow the words of Daniel, the parrot reporter: 'Under special circumstances, demon horns can grow like this, squawk!'
strings.그래서 적당히 잘라서 기념품으로 팔고 있어. 교단이 인증하고 데미갓이 정: So I've been cutting it into pieces and selling them as souvenirs. Fragments of a high-ranking demon's horn, certified by the Order and purified by a demigod.
They have no magic left, but they're still useful for various things, so they're popular.
At this rate, perhaps I'll be able to buy a proper house someday.
strings.집 살 돈 모으면서 그냥 이렇게 주셔도 돼요?: You're saving for a house. Are you sure you can just give this away?
strings.괜찮아. 널 돕는 건 여신을 돕는 거잖아. 교단에 이야기하면 알바 시급을: It's fine. Helping you means helping the goddess. If I tell the Order, they'll raise my hourly pay. It's great.
strings.혹시 잃어버렸으면 내게 다시 와. 똑같은 걸 줄게. 그러면 이제 됐지?: If you lose it, come back to me. I'll give you another one. That settles it, right? Oh, you also need an unpurified horn...
strings.형을 만난 적 있지?: You've met my brother, haven't you?
I don't really want to mention him, and you probably don't want to see him again, but... Hmm. It can't be helped.
Go there, use my name, and ask for a horn in repayment of his debt.
strings.정말 그러면 줄까요?: Will he really give me one?
strings.선량한 마족 말 한 번 믿어봐. 내가 직접 가고 싶긴 한데, 가자마자 안: Trust an honest demon for once. I'd like to go myself, but Andrea would kill me the moment I arrived...
Just the sort of fight brothers have.
strings.(로말리우스가 가볍게 웃으며 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Romalius chuckles and pats %s on the shoulder.)
I'll be off, then. It's time for my next job.
If you're really grateful, introduce me to a well-paid part-time job sometime.
strings.그러면 바유나 협곡으로 가보자. 리시테아의 문에 들어가기 전에 실피드 님: Then let's head to Vayuna Gorge. I'll see Sylphid before entering Lysithea's Gate...
Oh, %s. There was something I didn't get to say... Gone already.
strings.돈이 안 되는 일이지만, 착한 일 좀 해볼까?: It won't earn me anything, but shall I do a good deed?
strings.(작은 파랑새가 날갯짓을 하자 주위에 몰려있던 먼지가 흔적도 없이 사라진: (As the little bluebird flaps its wings, the dust gathered around it vanishes without a trace.)
strings.(실피드라고 불린 작은 파랑새가 놀라 뒤로 물러난다.): (The little bluebird called Sylphid startles and retreats.)
strings.찌르르. 처음 보는 사람이 날 빤히 쳐다봐서 새로 위장했는데…, 너일 줄: Chirrrp. Someone I didn't recognize was staring at me, so I disguised myself as a bird... I never thought it was you.
strings.찌르. 어떻게 한 거냐?: Chirp. How did you do that?
strings.(실피드와 헤어진 후, 도로시 마을에서 지내고 있다는 사실을 간단하게 이: (You briefly explain that since parting with Sylphid, you have been staying in Dorothy Village.)
strings.찌르르. 신기하군. 마녀가 만든 약의 효과에 그런 것도 있었다니. 게다가: Chirrrp. Remarkable. A witch's medicine has that effect too? And the witch's connection with Lady Iris is surprising as well.
strings.저도 신기하더라고요. 협곡은 이제 괜찮은 건가요?: I thought so too. Is the gorge all right now?
strings.찌르. 큰 문제는 없었다. 실핀이 많이 도와줘서 마계의 문 같은 게 나타: Chirp. No major problems. The Sylphin helped a great deal, so even when gates to the Demon Realm appeared, we destroyed them quickly.
That's a relief. But I haven't heard Iris's voice since then.
strings.찌르. 아마도 방법을 찾고 계신 것 같다. 내게도 목소리가 전해지지 않는: Chirp. She is probably searching for a way. I'm a little concerned that her voice hasn't reached me either, but for now, let's trust the goddess and wait.
strings.찌르르. 이제 저쪽 문으로 들어갈 거지?: Chirrrp. You're going through that gate now, right?
Yes. As I said, there's something needed in Dorothy Village...
strings.찌르. 문 안에 있는 마족 놈이 순순히 뿔을 줄지는 모르겠군. 방심은 언: Chirp. I don't know whether the demon inside will surrender his horn willingly. Never let your guard down.
strings.찌르르. 들어갔다가 위험한 일이 생기거나 내 도움이 필요할 거 같으면 찌: Chirrrp. If danger arises inside, or you think you need my help, shout 'Chirrrp!'
Chirp. It needn't be right now. You can do it later too.
Chirrrp. See you later, then. I'm off to teach a scoundrel a lesson.
strings.(실피드가 작은 날개를 흔들어 인사를 대신하고 힘차게 날아오른다.): (Sylphid waves a small wing in farewell and takes flight.)
strings.어, 그런데 나쁜 놈…. 누굴 말씀하시는 거지?: Wait, a scoundrel...? Who did he mean?
strings.(모험가가 여전히 많은 문 외에는 아무 것도 보이지 않는 공간을 두리번거: (The adventurer looks around the space, where there is still nothing to see but countless doors.)
strings.여길 다시 오게 될 줄이야. 안드레아를 어디서 찾지?: I never thought I'd come back here. Where can I find Andrea?
strings.(뭔가 느낀 모험가가 서둘러 뒤로 물러나자, 어디선가 날아온 화살이 바닥: (Sensing something, the adventurer hurriedly steps back. An arrow flies from somewhere and embeds itself in the floor.)
(A man with red horns slowly steps out between the small doors at the far end.)
To think you would return here...
strings.그래, 살아있었지. 살아서 뭐든 해야 하니까. 그건 그렇고 네놈은 질긴: Yes, alive. I must stay alive to do anything, after all. Did you come all this way to see whether this stubborn life still clings on?
You must know what entering this place means...
strings.(안드레아가 활시위를 들어 모험가를 조준한다.): (Andrea draws his bow and aims at the adventurer.)
I let my guard down then, but today my arrow will pierce your heart...
I came with a message from Romalius.
strings.(로말리우스라는 말에 안드레아가 활을 내린다.): (At Romalius's name, Andrea lowers his bow.)
He said you owe him a debt and told me to collect it on his behalf.
strings.설마 내 부러진 뿔이라도 가져가라고 한 건 아니겠지?: Don't tell me he told you to take my broken horn?
That's right. I need a broken horn from a high-ranking demon.
strings.재수 없는 녀석. 끝까지 자기만 생각하지. 럭스 놈이 부러뜨린 내 뿔을: That wretch. Thinking only of himself to the very end. Telling me to give a human the horn Lux broke...
strings.그래, 쓸모도 없는 뿔. 네게 주지. 대신, 날 즐겁게 만들어야 할 거야: Fine. It's a useless horn anyway. I'll give it to you. But first, you'll have to entertain me.
strings.(그 말과 함께 안드레아가 높은 곳에 있는 문으로 뛰어오른다. 그리고 문: (With those words, Andrea leaps toward a door high above and vanishes through the gap in an instant.)
I didn't really expect him to hand it over... It can't be helped. Let's go.
strings.(%s의 공격을 받아낸 안드레아가 뒤로 물러나 무기를 거둔다. 그리곤 품: (After taking %s's attack, Andrea steps back and puts away his weapon. Then he takes a broken horn from his clothes and throws it to %s.)
strings.이렇게 줘도 되는 거야?: You're really giving it to me?
strings.(모험가가 받아든 붉은색 뿔을 챙기고는 안드레아를 바라본다.): (The adventurer puts away the red horn and looks at Andrea.)
I've confirmed that you're capable of collecting the debt. That's all.
So otherwise, I might not have gotten it...
It would be a different matter if Romalius had come himself... But it feels good to be free of that debt.
Thanking someone who tried to kill you... How amusing.
strings.나가는 곳은 왼쪽 문이다. 나갈 때 발이 빠질 수 있으니 주의…. 잠깐: The exit is the door on the left. Watch your step; your foot may slip through when you leave... Wait, you...
You've met Lux. I can smell his foul stench on you.
strings.럭스가 마계 밖으로 나와 뭔가 꾸미고 있는 건 알았지만, 네가 만날 줄은: I knew Lux had left the Demon Realm and was plotting something, but I never expected you to meet him. Hahaha.
I have no reason to tell you that.
strings.내게서 괜찮은 정보가 나올지도 모를 텐데, 그런 자세를 취할 건가?: Is that the attitude you'll take when I might have useful information?
I'll hear it first and decide.
Hehe. I'm trapped here anyway, so it makes no difference. Then I'll tell you.
strings.그쪽에 있는 럭스는 제대로 된 럭스가 아니다. 마계에 있는 자신의 일부를: The Lux on that side isn't the complete Lux. He split off a part of himself in the Demon Realm and sent it into the human world.
strings.레메게톤인가 뭔가를 완성하는데, 그것만 얻어내면 모든 게 끝날 거라고 했: He was completing something called the Lemegeton. He said that once he obtained what he wanted, everything would be over.
strings.그게 뭔지는 나도 잘 모른다. 그게 뭔지 알았다면 내가 여기 있겠어? 내: I don't know what it is. If I knew, would I be here? I would have killed Lux and taken it myself.
strings.마계의 거의 모든 걸 손에 넣은 럭스가 더 원하는 게 있다면 뻔하지 않아: Lux has almost everything in the Demon Realm. Isn't it obvious what else he could want? To become a god.
From your expression, something serious must have happened. Then answer just one thing. Did Lux create something connected to a god?
And you, the goddess's follower, stopped it.
Now leave. You'll be in the way when I walk Hellfire.
strings.(안드레아가 피식 웃고는 근처에 있는 문 하나를 열고 들어간다.): (Andrea gives a faint laugh, opens a nearby door, and goes inside.)
I learned something new about Lux, but it leaves me uneasy.
Phew. I've got everything I need, so let's return to the village.
strings.저 하늘 위에 그게 있는 거 맞지?: It's up there in the sky, right?
Act as though nothing's wrong, just as the boss said. I'll handle the rest.
strings.(루노가 엘리엇의 어깨를 두드리고는 마을에서 호숫가 물이 차오르는 방향으: (Runo pats Elliot's shoulder and walks toward the side of the village where the lakeshore rises.)
strings.(잠시 후, 하늘을 날고 있던 티페타가 속도를 줄이며 건물 위로 내려와: (Soon, Tipeta slows in flight and lands atop a building.)
Ugh, how annoying. What a pain.
strings.뿔 잘린 마족이 던진 돌에 맞질 않나. 어디서 참새들이 쫓아와서 앞을 막: A demon with cut-off horns threw a rock at me. Then sparrows came chasing after me and blocked my path. Then skeletal dogs tried to bite me...
strings.괜히 따라갔어. 그냥 기다리고 있을 걸. 그놈의 호기심이 문제지. 아!: I shouldn't have followed. I should've just waited. My curiosity is the problem. Oh! Elliot. Elliot!
strings.엘리엇, 언니 왔어. 기다렸지? 후후, 어차피 넌 나를 못 보겠지만 말이: Elliot, your big sister's back. Were you waiting? Hehe, you can't see me anyway. Oh, the hero is coming too.
strings.엘리엇, 이제 나 뿔만 가지고 에메랄디아로 돌아갈 거야. 그러니까 언니: Elliot, I'm going to take the horns and return to Emeraldia now. So don't cry even if you miss me. Understood?
Yes... I was talking with Runo...
strings.엘리엇, 부탁한 뿔…. 얼굴이 창백한데, 어디 아파요?: Elliot, the horns you asked for... Your face is pale. Are you ill?
strings.(갑자기 등장한 루노가 뛰어올라 등에 있던 검을 휘두른다. 그러자 조금: (Runo suddenly appears, leaps up, and swings the sword from his back. Someone who was invisible to %s moments ago appears and parries the attack.)
strings.감히 내가 애지중지 기른 머리를 자르려고?! 그렇게는 안 돼, 이 늙은: How dare you try to cut the hair I've cherished and grown?! Not a chance, you old deer!!
strings.(루노가 다시 티페타를 향해 공격하려고 하지만, 약 올리려고 하는 것처럼: (Runo tries to attack Tipeta again, but she flies higher into the sky as though taunting him.)
Tch... A cursed dragonfolk, of all things...
Elliot, you could see me from the beginning, couldn't you?
strings.(엘리엇이 티페타와 눈이 마주치자 소스라치게 놀라 도망간다.): (When Elliot's eyes meet Tipeta's, he recoils in terror and runs.)
strings.너는 누구지? 마을 사람은 아닌 것 같은데…. 그 뿔하고 날개, 꼬리는…: Who are you? You don't seem to be from the village... Those horns, wings, and tail...
strings.안녕, 용사님. 나 정말 용사님 만나고 싶었어. 보고 싶었다니까. 오랫동: Hello, hero. I really wanted to meet you. I've missed you, you know. I've waited so long, and I'm so happy we finally meet.
Hero, I'm Tipeta. Remember my name. All right? Hehe.
strings.그런데 어쩌지? 이 뿔 힘들게 가져왔다는 걸 아는데, 지금 내 손에 있네: But what a shame. I know you worked hard to get these horns, yet now they're in my hands.
strings.(티페타가 활짝 웃으며 두 개의 뿔 조각이 담긴 주머니를 들어 보인다.): (Grinning, Tipeta holds up a pouch containing the two horn fragments.)
Hehe. When a dragonfolk puts her mind to it, she's faster than a spirit of light.
strings.이 뿔, 좋은 곳에 쓸게. 이게 겨우 마음을 위한 영약 같은 걸 만들 재: I'll put these horns to good use. They aren't ingredients to waste on some mere elixir for the heart.
strings.그리고, 거기 사슴 아저씨. 내가 모르는 줄 알았지? 이쪽으로 한 발짝만: And you, Mr. Deer. You thought I didn't notice? Take one more step toward me. Go on, if you want to watch Elliot die right here.
strings.어허, 용사님도 그만둬. 여기 나만 있다고 생각하는 건 아니겠지?: Ah-ah, you too, hero. Stop. You don't think I'm the only one here, do you?
Would you be happy if the whole village disappeared? I don't want that either. Hehe.
strings.그러면 안녕. 다시 만날 일은 없겠지만, 만약 만나게 되면 죽는다는 걸: Goodbye, then. We probably won't meet again, but if we do, don't forget that you'll die. Understood?
strings.(티페타가 만족스러운 표정을 보이고는 힘차게 날갯짓한다. 그러고는 가도: (Looking satisfied, Tipeta beats her wings and flies toward the road, disappearing from sight.)
strings.(루노가 서둘러 엘리엇의 상태를 살피고는 한숨을 내쉰다.): (Runo hurriedly checks Elliot and lets out a sigh.)
strings.다행이다. 잠깐 기절한것 뿐이야. …한동안 기절하지 않고 잘 버티던 녀석: Thank goodness. He only fainted... He'd been holding up so well without fainting lately, and now this...
We need to tell Glinda right away.
strings.그건 내가 할 테니 날 따라와라. 엘리엇을 집에 눕혀두고 나올 테니까 앞: I'll handle that. Follow me. I'll put Elliot to bed, so wait outside for a moment.
strings.(루노가 주위를 살펴보고는 모험가를 바라본다.): (Runo checks the surroundings, then looks at the adventurer.)
Don't worry about Elliot. He's taken a sedative and fallen asleep.
That's a relief. About that girl... You called her a dragonfolk.
strings.용인에 대해서 모르는군. 혹시 드래코니안이라고 들어봤나?: So you don't know about dragonfolk. Have you heard the term Draconian?
I think I've heard it somewhere.
strings.인간들이 수인이라고 부르는 부류 중 하나다. 용인 혹은 드래코니안이라고: They're one of the groups humans call beastfolk. They're called dragonfolk or Draconians.
strings.그들의 선조 중에 사악한 드래곤이 있다고 하는데, 인간과 섞이면서 후손들: They say an evil dragon was among their ancestors. After mingling with humans, all their descendants were born in that form.
They resemble beastfolk, but are known for their tremendous strength.
strings.한때는 프레이오스 대륙의 한 축을 담당하던 큰 세력이었지만, 마족과 결탁: They were once a major power on the continent of Freios, but became corrupted after allying with demons.
strings.그래서 혼돈의 하늘 즈음에 많은 세력들이 연합을 이뤄 토벌했다고 들었다…: I heard that around the time of the Chaotic Sky, many factions formed an alliance and subdued them...
strings.그런데 왜 마을에 온 걸까요?: But why did she come to the village?
strings.자세한 건 나도 모른다. 멸종된 자들이 왜 나타났는지, 왜 우리 마을에: I don't know the details either. Why a people thought extinct have appeared, or why they came to our village...
I need to get those things back right away.
They took something Elliot needs. I have to recover it.
It isn't a guest's concern. We'll handle it.
strings.다시 한번 말하지. 도로시 마을의 일은 마을 사람들이 처리할 거야. 넌: I'll say it again. The people of Dorothy Village will deal with our own affairs. You came at the goddess's request, so rest quietly before you leave.
strings.이걸로 부탁하는 건 끝이다. 이제 경고지. 만약 보스가 직접 나서는 상황: That is the last time I ask. Now it is a warning. If the boss has to intervene personally...
I hope it never comes to that.
strings.(당장 어떤 대답도 못 들을 것 같네…. 나중에 이야기해 보자. 가능할진: (It doesn't seem I'll get any answers right now... I'll try talking later. If I can...)
strings.(루노가 대화를 포기하고 돌아가는 모험가를 말없이 바라보다 한숨을 내쉰다: (Runo silently watches the adventurer give up on the conversation and leave, then sighs.)
For now, all we can do is follow the boss's wishes...
